A '''Rebel Marksman''' was a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="BF1" /> They were typically equipped with an [[E-17d sniper rifle/Legends|E-17d sniper rifle]], a [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]] as a side-arm, [[Class-A thermal detonator/Legends|Class-A thermal detonators]], and an [[R-4 recon droid]],<ref name="BF1 guide>[[Star Wars Battlefront: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Battlefront'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> but some were outfitted with [[Autoturret/Legends|autoturrets]] in place of recon droids.<ref name="BF2">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>

Rebel marksmen were deployed on many battlefields during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], including the [[raid on Yavin 4]], the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="BF1" /> They were motivated individuals, and a squad of them were capable of routing a whole [[Company/Legends|company]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="BF1 guide" /> A prominent number of Rebel marksmen were women.<ref name="BF1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel marksman fills the sniper class role for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in the [[Star Wars Battlefront (series)|''Star Wars: Battlefront'']] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] series. Rebel snipers also appear in the Endor downloadable expansion to the [[2010]] video game ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', an alternate Battle of Endor scenario.

===Non-canon history===
A squad of snipers accompanied a Rebel strike force to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] in an attempt to destroy the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] protecting the under-construction [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]]. They were all killed by the [[Dark Apprentice]], the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Galen Marek]].
